name: Wisp
description: Fast, lightweight HLS/IPTV and internet radio player that runs entirely in your browser. No accounts, no server, no tracking.

paragraphs: A fast, lightweight player for HLS / IPTV playlists and internet radio that runs entirely in your browser.

Paste an M3U playlist or a stream link and Wisp shows the channels, grouped and searchable, and plays them with adaptive streaming tuned for slow and unstable connections. Switch to Radio to browse more than 40,000 internet radio stations from the free Radio Browser directory.
Wisp runs entirely in the browser with no proxy server. That keeps it free to host and simple to trust, but browsers enforce rules that native apps like VLC don't have to follow:
features: TV: open an M3U/M3U8 playlist by link, by pasting its text, or from a file. Channels are grouped by category, numbered, searchable, and scroll smoothly even with 10,000+ entries.
Direct links: HLS streams (.m3u8) and video/audio files (.mp4, .webm, .mp3, …) play straight away.

Smart detection: one box takes a link or pasted playlist text. Wisp peeks at the first bytes of a link to see what it really is. The optional Type menu is only a hint: if it's wrong, Wisp tries the other ways of playing…
Radio: search more than 40,000 stations by name, country or genre.
Multiview: watch up to four streams in a grid. The screen with the red tally frame has the sound. The others are muted and kept at their lowest quality to save bandwidth.

requirements.text: No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking.
